newsitem.title: FRANCE: Milosevic, Izetbegovic to announce agreement.
newsitem.headline: Milosevic, Izetbegovic to announce agreement.

text.p: Presidents Slobodan Milosevic of Serbia and Alija Izetbegovic of Bosnia will announce agreement on "concrete steps" to improve relations later on Thursday, sources close to their Paris summit said.

The sources said the former enemies had made progress in a first two-hour session on Thursday morning and would hold a joint news conference after a second working session, following lunch with French President Jacques Chirac.

Milosevic told reporters the first meeting with the newly elected leader of Bosnia's three-man presidency "went well". They met at the Hotel de Marigny state guesthouse opposite the Elysee presidential palace.
Diplomats said they were expected to announce an exchange of diplomatic missions and the opening of road, rail, air and telecommunications links.

Chirac promised France and the European Union would continue to aid Bosnia's recovery and told Izetbegovic he had "an essential role to play to make peace a success...(and) personify a tolerant Bosnia reconciled at last with itself", a French official said.
